data_fields.name: cast_time_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: castTime (s) * 1000, per-rank ramp initRamp, add or multiply flag

data_fields.name: recycle_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: recycleTime (s) * 1000 with ramp recycleRamp, plus cast time

data_fields.name: cost_ramp
data_fields.donor_constant: cost times (1 + costRamp * rank) or cost + costRamp * rank

data_fields.name: visible_cast_threshold_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 ms; above it the caster is flagged as casting

data_fields.name: move_grace_s
data_fields.donor_constant: one second of remaining movement lets a non-move-cast power through

data_fields.name: max_rank
data_fields.donor_constant: maxTrains per power; player trains clamped to it

data_fields.name: hit_chance_cap_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: 94 when attacker rating beats defense or defense is 0

data_fields.name: hit_chance_floor_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 when the rating ratio is at or below 0.8

best_idea: Start the recycle lock at cast press (lock = cast time plus recycle time), let movement or damage cancel only the powers flagged for it, and void a cast whose caster has died or changed life counter, so the cooldown and cast bars never disagree with the server.
decision_why: The lock-from-cast-start and flag-driven cancels fit a server-verified fight; the donor has two gaps for us (no cost refund on cancel, silent drop when stunned at completion), which the adapted version fixes with one ledger entry and an explicit fail event.
acceptance: Server test: a power with 1.2 s cast and 4 s recycle locks from cast press to 5.2 s; a second cast press during the cast is refused; moving during a power not castable while moving cancels it and releases the lock in the same tick; the cost is refunded once.
